 . 3. Return Conditions and Refund Eligibility
A standard return must satisfy the applicable category window and condition requirements. Nimbus Commerce
may reject a return if the product is materially used, intentionally damaged, incomplete, counterfeit, substituted,
or returned with missing essential components.
A return does not automatically mean that a refund has already been issued. The normal sequence is: return
request, eligibility validation, return authorization, physical receipt, inspection, approval, refund initiation,
payment-provider processing, and customer account confirmation.
If an item fails inspection because of customer-caused damage, Nimbus Commerce may offer a partial refund,
store credit, replacement option, or return the item to the customer. The final action depends on the severity of
the issue and the applicable category rules.
For seller-fulfilled products, the seller’s approved return conditions may apply when explicitly identified on the
order.
